learning_outcomes.text: Define key pathophysiology concepts: aetiology, pathogenesis, clinical manifestations and sequelae
Explain cellular responses to injury including adaptation, reversible injury and cell death
Describe the inflammatory response and the stages of tissue healing
Relate common disease mechanisms to the signs and symptoms they produce
Distinguish acute from chronic disease processes using representative examples
Explain how disturbances in one system produce downstream effects in others

integrative_case: A pathophysiology student receives a written case describing a patient with long-standing high blood pressure who develops reduced kidney function and leg swelling; the task is to explain the chain of mechanisms linking the systems, without diagnosing or recommending treatment for any real person.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
